name: EducationInBarriers: Accessibility Barriers in Education. Barreras de Accesibilidad en Educación.
summary: This lab is designed to build your critical eye for inclusive design and raise your awareness of how small details in an environment can either support, or hinder, learning for all students. In front of you are three portals that will take you into different classrooms. Each classroom represents a different context and hides physical, sensory, or communication barriers for you to discover. Espacio pensado para reflexionar sobre barreras de accesibilidad que pueden encontrarse en un entorno educativo real.
